name: fullstack-web-project
description: Full-stack application built with Next.js, React, Node.js, Express, and TypeScript

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
